entries.name: Emdexium
entries.description: A "Swiss Army Knife" type Cyber deck, built from scratch. It runs Linux (Emdexium Linux), Windows (Via its triple boot system!), and a ESP 32 microcontroller for IoT.

entries.name: ANON
entries.description: My narrative-driven 1st person game that will be available on steam once finished. It is a PCVR only game and will be physics driven with realistic graphics powered by Unreal Engine. Keep in mind development has stopped and when it does continue, it is just a fun side project, so don't expect it soon.
